subject: Quick: Hands-on walkthrough for your recent usage spike
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Eli Torres <eli@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick: Hands-on walkthrough for your recent usage spike

Hi Eli —

Congrats on the recent ramp — I noticed BrightPath crossed one of our usage thresholds this week (awesome!). We often see a few quick wins when a small walkthrough covers: routing, prefix/KV cache settings, and a couple of low-effort quantization options that reduce per-token cost without hurting output quality.

Would you be open to a 20-minute, hands-on session where we:
- Walk through your current request profile (latency & token mix)
- Show 2 quick configuration changes you can make today
- Answer engineering questions about rollout and canarying

Here are a few windows that work for me (all PT):
- Wed Jun 17 — 11:00am–11:25am PT
- Thu Jun 18 — 9:30am–9:55am PT
- Thu Jun 18 — 2:00pm–2:25pm PT

Or send a time that works for your team and I’ll make it happen. If you can, share who from your side will join (engineer/product).

Quick links: calendly.com/redwood/karthik (pick a slot) — I’ll send a short agenda and a checklist ahead of time.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
SDR, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com
p: (415) 555-0192

--
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference for teams

Wed Jun 17 at 11:00am PT works for me. Id like to include our engineering lead Andrew Park (andrew@brightpath.ai) and our product manager Sarah Lane (sarah@brightpath.ai) if possible. Will that be okay?

High level agenda wed like to cover:
- Average tail latency and any quick wins for responsiveness
- Cost/throughput tradeoffs for quantized variants
- Any gotchas when moving from self-serve to a dedicated pool

Also: can you share a one-page agenda and any pre-reads? Well be tight on time so that will help us focus.

Thanks again — Eli

See you Wednesday — calendar invite should include a Zoom link. If anything changes, ping me and well reschedule.
